title: repeat_masking pipeline parameters
description: Ensembl repeat masking pipeline. Runs RepeatMasker (RepBase + optional custom library), RED, TRF, and DUST. Outputs softmasked FASTA and a merged repeat GFF3.

genome_fasta.description: Path to unmasked reference genome FASTA.

outdir.description: Output directory. Softmasked FASTA, repeat GFF3, and output_manifest.json written here.

repbase_library.description: Path to RepBase repeat library file for RepeatMasker (e.g. RepeatMaskerLib.h5).

custom_library.description: Path to custom repeat library FASTA (e.g. from RepeatModeler). Optional.

species.description: Species name passed to RepeatMasker -species flag (e.g. 'homo sapiens'). Used when repbase_library is not specified.

skip_repeatmodeler.description: Skip de novo repeat library construction with RepeatModeler.

repeatmasker_threads.description: Threads to use per RepeatMasker job.

chunk_size.description: Genome chunk size in bp for parallelising RepeatMasker (default: 10 Mb).
